title: Simons' theorem (Simon B.2) for C¹ hypercones minimizing area under deformations away from the vertex (parent B5e–B9)
statement: Simons' theorem for deformation-minimal C¹ hypercones. Data: P, m ∈ ℕ with 2 ≤ m ≤ 6; a linear subspace A₀ ⊆ ℝ^P with dim A₀ = m + 1; M ⊆ ℝ^P. Hypotheses: M ≠ ∅, M ⊆ A₀ and 0 ∉ M; M is an embedded C¹ m-submanifold of ℝ^P; closure(M) ⊆ M ∪ {0}; tx ∈ M for every x ∈ M and t > 0; M has an orientation ξ (IsOrientation m M ξ for some ξ); H^m(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K; and for every C^∞ map Z : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with compact support and 0 ∉ tsupport Z there is t₀ > 0 with H^m(M ∩ tsupport Z) ≤ H^m({x + tZ(x) : x ∈ M ∩ tsupport Z}) for every t with |t| < t₀. Conclusion: there is a linear subspace H₀ ⊆ ℝ^P with dim H₀ = m and M = H₀ ∖ {0}. H^m = μHE[m].
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)), 2 ≤ m → m ≤ 6 → Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M.Nonempty → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → (0 : Euclid P) ∉ M → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → closure M ⊆ insert 0 M → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ x ∈ M, t • x ∈ M) → (∃ ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m, IsOrientation m M ξ) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ Z : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Z → HasCompactSupport Z → (0 : Euclid P) ∉ tsupport Z → ∃ t₀ : ℝ, 0 < t₀ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < t₀ → μHE[m] (M ∩ tsupport Z) ≤ μHE[m] ((fun x => x + t • Z x) '' (M ∩ tsupport Z))) → ∃ H₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ H₀ = m ∧ M = (H₀ : Set (Euclid P)) \ {0}
